# FastExcelHelper

[![tests](https://github.com/aVadim483/fast-excel-helper/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/aVadim483/fast-excel-helper/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

Requires PHP 7.4 or above, the package is tested on PHP 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 and 8.5.

Collection of functions for several packages:
* https://github.com/aVadim483/fast-excel-reader
* https://github.com/aVadim483/fast-excel-writer
* https://github.com/aVadim483/fast-excel-templator
* https://github.com/aVadim483/fast-excel-laravel
